description:
Returns a specific space.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to view the space.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the space to be returned.

parameters.name: description-format
parameters.description: The content format type to be returned in the `description` field of the response. If available, the representation will be available under a response field of the same name under the `description` field.

parameters.name: include-icon
parameters.description: If the icon for the space should be fetched or not.

parameters.name: include-operations
parameters.description:
Includes operations associated with this space in the response, as defined in the `Operation` object.
The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order.
A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.

parameters.name: include-properties
parameters.description:
Includes space properties associated with this space in the response.
The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order.
A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.

parameters.name: include-permissions
parameters.description:
Includes space permissions associated with this space in the response.
The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order.
A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.

parameters.name: include-role-assignments
parameters.description:
Includes role assignments associated with this space in the response. This parameter is only accepted for EAP sites.
The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order.
A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.

parameters.name: include-labels
parameters.description:
Includes labels associated with this space in the response.
The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order.
A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.

200.description: Returned if the requested space is returned.

base.description: Base url of the Confluence site.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description:
Returned if the calling user does not have permission to view the
requested space or the space was not found.
